requirements.scope: Nominal contact task and unchanged source operating-demand checks. Fault scenarios are separately executed; power-loss payload retention and hardware are not qualified.

qualification.construction: native authored geometry and explicit mass records
qualification.dynamics: actual MuJoCo integration of declared electrical drives, mechanical constraints and contacts
qualification.clearance: project-declared contact and native clearance scope; not a complete continuous B-rep motion envelope

limitations: Four deforming spring coil visuals are omitted; spring forces remain in the physical model.
Internal input shafts, drive pulleys, pinion and belt teeth retain native local phase; separate rotor/belt material states are not recorded.
Flexible cable harness is omitted; contacts use the separate declared conservative proxy model.
Workbench surface is omitted from the display; its authored physical contacts remain active.
Workpiece bore is native visual geometry; its physical contact primitive remains the declared cylinder.
Display finishes are source appearance, not a measured material or manufacturing qualification.
scope: Rerendered native geometry at accepted integrated model states. Recorded state holds are explicit. Images do not qualify manufacturing, continuous clearance, contact fidelity or hardware capacity.
